{{Top|leg}}
An '''Andalian tapestry''' was a type of [[Tapestry/Legends|tapestry]]<ref name="Big Quince">{{JournalCite|2|Big Quince (short story)}}</ref> originating in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Andalian [[Tapestry/Legends|tapestry]]|system=Andalia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster's]] [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Quincey's Girl]]'', the [[Sludir]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Quintik Kahr]] covered a wall of his private quarters with an Andalian tapestry, among other stolen treasures.<ref name="Big Quince" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andalian tapestries were first introduced in the short story "[[Big Quince (disambiguation)|Big Quince]]," collected within [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 2]]<ref name="Big Quince" /> released in [[May]] [[1994]].<ref name="SWAJ 2">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 2]]</ref>
